sources.title: GTA 6's Jason and Lucia Actors Break Years of Silence With New Joint Statement
sources.text: GTA 6's lead actors, Dylan Rourke and Manni L. Perez , have broken their multi-year streak of silence about starring in the game. With GTA 6 officially being out now, the game's full cast has officially been announced . Rockstar kept the actors under a veil of secrecy for the better part of a decade, though some fans were able to figure out who they were thanks to some sleuthing. Still, despite this, the actors maintained strong poker faces, and it's honestly commendable how well they kept their roles under wraps. To celebrate the game's launch, Rourke (who plays Jason) and Perez (who plays Lucia) released a joint statement on their Instagram accounts about their experience working on the game. "Years witnessing the hardest working and most skilled artisans game making has to offer," reads their statement. "We are truly honored to collaborate on this worldwide testament to human creativity, ingenuity, and sheer willpower. So much learned and so much to learn, keep fighting for what you love, stay humble. See y’all in Leonida." Perez's role was technically confirmed earlier this week when she was nominated for Best Performance at The Game Awards. Jason and Lucia have been receiving all kinds of praise for their hyper-detailed relationship, which allows players to roleplay a romantic and nuanced kinship. There hasn't really been anything quite like it in gaming, though that has also led to some annoyance from a certain group of fans who just want a straight-up crime game without the lovey-dovey fluff. Still, there is plenty of crime to be found in this game, obviously. GTA 6's sketchy cast of characters is supported by plenty of new, up-and-coming talent along with some more familiar faces like Bobby Moynihan and Stephen Root ( who leaked his own role earlier this year ). Whether this will catapult Perez and Rourke into more mainstream roles following GTA 6 remains to be seen. GTA 5's Steven Ogg (who played Trevor) was cast in shows like The Walking Dead and Better Call Saul following the game's release. Given GTA 6 is likely going to have the biggest launch in entertainment history, these two actors are about to become some of the most recognizable faces and voices in gaming. sources.title: Can Jason and Lucia Get Naked in GTA 6?
sources.text: Let’s settle this once and for all. Can Jason and Lucia get naked in GTA 6 ? Ever since the couple were revealed as the co-protagonists of GTA 6, it feels like that one question has been asked more than any other. Not, “How will the robbery gameplay systems work?” or, “Does the driving feel as exquisitely dangerous as it did in GTA 4?,” but instead, people just want to know how much skin will be on show. Who am I to judge? Upon booting up GTA 6 for the first time, within its opening hours I’d already located one nudist bar and spent a little too long examining the variety of appendages on show. There’s no shortage of NPC nudity out there in Leonida. People walk along beaches, run out into the street, and sit by pools with no clothes covering their decency. But, how about Jason and Lucia? Just getting started in GTA 6 or wondering what to do next? Check out the Official Grand Theft Auto 6 guide right here on IGN. If you're still getting your bearings, discover GTA's new systems with the Beginner's Guide - 67 Tips and Tricks , or get all the details on the first chapters with the Chapter 1 Guide and Tips and Chapter 2 Guide and Tips . If you're already driving all around Leonida and want to know everything there is to find and do, see the Leonida interactive map . Showering can (and should, if you don’t want to stink) play a huge part in your daily routine in GTA 6. Not only does it boost your focus bar, but can have other gameplay ramifications, such as enemy humans and animals being able to pick up your scent more easily. Of course, showering should be done with no clothes on — unless you’re playing the Japanese version of Grand Theft Auto 6, that is — and you can scrub up both Jason and Lucia from a camera view deliberately angled so you don’t get a good look around the front of them. I’m sure you’ve tried by now if you’re reading this, but no matter how forcefully you push that right stick, you’ll never get the angle you’re looking for. GTA 6 simply does not want you to see its lead character’s genitals. They bare their soul in their epic story, so this is the least grace we can give them. Sex can play a big part in Jason and Lucia’s story if you choose to engage in it, though. Build a strong enough relationship between them, and you’ll occasionally get a prompt to engage in a spot of physical intimacy, whether that be in bed, in the shower, on the sofa, or other spots around the house. While, again, these scenes aren’t overly explicit with full frontal nudity never on show, both can be naked, with topless scenes not uncommon. If nipples are what you’re seeking, you shall find them. So, can you see Jason and Lucia naked? Yes, and no. Intimate scenes often involve no clothes, but you’re never going to come close to watching a porn film here. That would just be odd. The least you can ever walk around your home wearing is underwear, and if you try to leave the house, further clothes will be magically added to your character to spare their decency. Despite some wild and weird things available for you to find in GTA 6’s open world, it ultimately does want you to treat its leads as real humans, not complete freaks. Despite what some past leaks may have suggested , you can’t roam the streets of Vice City completely nude for all the world to see. You are, however, free to do that in real life, but you will likely end up in jail. We have plenty more GTA 6 coverage for you at IGN, from letting you know how long the game takes to beat to the optional missions you really shouldn’t miss . sources.title: You can't cheat on Lucia in GTA 6 with Mandy or strippers because Rockstar doesn't believe that's 'complementary to the feeling and motivations' of Jason and Lucia's story
sources.text: God forbid you experience a happy and healthy relationship. My greatest regret about Grand Theft Auto 6 's release is that I didn't make an 'angry players' bingo card beforehand. Seriously, with how predictable all the outrage is, I could've had the winning card by now, and the game's not even been out for 24 hours yet. What would I have on my bingo card? Well, a couple of things that'd be on there are: angry at 30 fps, angry at shooting police (a classic), and slap-bang in the middle I'd have angry that you can't cheat (the other kind of cheat ) on your partner. It seems that there's a group of players who are taking issue with the fact that GTA 6's story revolves around Jason and Lucia's relationship and therefore you can't pick up other women like strippers or Mandy, an early side character who players seem to be quite preoccupied with right now. Although, I haven't heard anyone complain that Lucia can't get with other guys. You can still go to strip clubs, though. You can even go as a couple; how modern. But Rockstar hasn't added the ability to do much more simply because it doesn't fit with the story. In a statement to Shacknews Rockstar explains: "GTA 6 is a game about a couple in a bind, lovers on the run. While we have taken a lot forward from previous GTA titles, everything we have implemented in [GTA 6] has been done to support the spirit of the story we wanted to tell, and the gameplay systems we wanted to expand upon—things like the wanted system, the radio, robberies and car theft. Many aspects of previous titles are not present in GTA 6, but the elements we have we believe are all necessary and complementary to the feeling and motivations we wanted to emphasise as you play through Jason and Lucia's story." Honestly, it makes sense. Given the fact that this story clearly revolves around the two of them you'd probably have a considerably worse time towards the end if there was an option to break the couple up. It's bad enough running into your ex in public, but imagine having to do a bank heist with them? Yeah, no thanks. I'm sure once (or whenever) GTA 6 online comes out players will be able to do whatever they please. But for now you'll have to stay within the confine of GTA 6's storylines, which means being in a loving relationship, how sad. sources.title: GTA 6 players confirm "True Fat Jason" and "max weight Lucia" aren't very fat at all
sources.text: GTA 6 has barely been out for a day, but players have already speedrun to reach Lucia and Jason's maximum weight limits. Turns out, neither of their biggest weights is that big at all, so I have a sneaking suspicion the inevitable PC mods will likely turn them into absolute units. Mere hours after the game's midnight launch, Twitter user Sir Joseph Windsor posted their "Overweight Strong" Jason (below), a version of the character that seemed to have equal parts body fat and muscle. A solid diet of high-strength weight workouts and fast food, no doubt. But the fan base was still hungry to see an even chubbier Jason. "I didn't want to let the community down so it is finally done. I present to you: max weight, low muscle Jason AKA the True Fat Jason. Now I can finally sleep in peace after this GTA 6 marathon. I should probably make a guide on how to do this," they write. The GTA 6 fat speedrunner then posted a brief guide for anyone looking to also put meat onto Jason or Lucia's bones. First, you need to eat at least four burgers or tacos from the game's various fast food chains. Then go to sleep. Then stuff your face with more fast food. Damaging your vehicle will soon prompt you to repair it, which will take you to a loading screen where, hopefully, your character's calories have sunk in. And, voila, apparently. Important note: you'll want to avoid doing workouts as either character for this to work. Twitterer Akkyon also posted what "max weight Lucia" looks like. Neither seems quite as big as Arthur Morgan's at his heaviest, though I'm guessing there's only so big Lucia and Jason can get before their crime antics start to look a little unbelievable. Regardless, whenever GTA 6 does drop on PC, you can probably expect modders to stretch those waistlines as far as possible. Rockstar hasn't formally announced a PC port for GTA 6 , but based on past trends, we wouldn't necessarily expect it before November 2027. sources.text: Grand Theft Auto 6 brings back the weight and muscle mechanics that let your characters bodiesâ fluctuate between absolutely jacked and a bit on the heavier side. Rockstar has mostly shown Jason, one half of the duo the player controls in the game, as an absolutely chiseled-to-the-gods gym goer, but if you want to get him off his training regimen, you can do that and see where it goes. Fans have already been testing the limits of the system in the gameâs first day in the wild, and the way it accounts for both muscle mass and body fat means that thereâs a pretty wide range of variations possible in terms of Jasonâs physique. By default, Jason starts out with âhighâ muscle and âlowâ body fat, but if you eat stuff thatâs bad for you and donât exercise to balance it out, those values will shift, and his character model will change. Twitter user @SirJosephWindsr has already tried maxing out both, and you can see the difference between a high-muscle and highâbody fat build and a low-muscle and highâbody fat one. Briefly pausing my GTA 6 marathon to share my Max Weight, Low Muscle Jason. by u/TheKey32 in GTA6 Max Muscle with Max Fat Jason Duval AKA "Overweight Strong" in GTA 6 for those wondering, he looked fatter when i had less strength so if you want him to look fatter dont do make him exercise lol. pic.twitter.com/Kn4UzTa4dA — Sir Joseph Windsor (@SirJosephWindsr) November 18, 2026 The same applies to Lucia, though I would say the difference between her default state and her max-weight state isnât quite as drastic as Jasonâs, though it is definitely still noticeable. A lot of GTA 6 seems to focus on mundane tasks, and I guess thatâs the appeal for some folks. I definitely want to do a more in-depth look into the exercise and weight-gain systems as Kotaku âs local gym rat down the line, so Iâll report back once I know more. sources.title: GTA 6 Devs Reveal Movie Inspirations for Jason and Lucia
sources.text: GTA 6’s senior vice president of narrative has revealed the movies that inspired Jason and Lucia’s characters, including Bonnie and Clyde, Pulp Fiction and more. Since the announcement trailer for GTA 6, players have been speculating that the new installment is going to be a Bonnie and Clyde story, just through their dynamic and, of course, what the GTA franchise is known for. When creating these characters, the devs had a look at a lot of ‘couple on the run’ movies that you can check out below: In a new interview with Game Informer , GTA 6’s senior vice president of narrative, Rupert Humphries, was asked whether the dev team looked at movies for inspiration for Jason and Lucia’s dynamic. Humphries revealed that the process started by watching ‘couple on the run’ movies, and the ones that stuck with them were Bonnie and Clyde, The Getaway, True Romance, Thelma and Louise, and Out of Sight. The team also took a look at buddy movies for Jason and Lucia’s banter, including Riggs and Murtaugh, Butch and Sundance, Mike Lowry and Marcus Burnett, and more. There were other inspirations too, such as Pulp Fiction and Natural Born Killers, to have characters that change based on their enjoyment of a crime spree. Humphries concluded, stating, “Jason and Lucia are a lot tougher than Tim Roth and Amanda Plummer, but we liked the idea of telling a story where Jason and Lucia could end up being closer to either end of that spectrum based on what the player was doing.” What are your thoughts on the movie inspirations for GTA 6’s Jason and Lucia? sources.title: Can You Make Jason & Lucia Fully Naked in GTA 6? Frontal Nudity, Explained
sources.text: It’s one of the two big questions that many people have wondered about going into GTA 6: So we’re going to clear all up the details about whether you can see Jason and Lucia fully naked from the front in their birthday suits. You need a bonk on the head and sent to you-know-what jail if you’re here. Then again, I’m writing this because I wondered it, and knew you would, too. So let’s stop pretending any of us are innocent here, and get into this GTA 6 guide. You can buy Grand Theft Auto 6 here if you haven’t already! Yes, GTA 6 features full frontal nudity, as you are able to see certain male and female characters completely naked from the front, exposing their genitalia. If you’re unfamiliar with Rockstar Games , the company’s titles aren’t strangers to this level of nudity, as Red Dead fans will know. However, the game does have various NPCs appear completely naked, kind of a necessity when you have a Nudist Resort in GTA 6 . I (Jason) also had the displeasure of watching an old drunk man at a urinal, with his manhood on full display, emptying the whole contents of his night’s drinks from said manhood. What a game. Jason and Lucia do appear fully naked in GTA 6 when you take showers with them, and when they are intimate with each other after you reach a certain level of relationship with each other. For the first few hours of GTA 6, the most you’ll see of either of them naked is Jason in the shower. You can take one at any point in the safehouse, and you’ll see Jason from behind, with a cheeky inclusion of his rear end. Eventually, you gain access to Lucia . Once this happens, you’ll be able to cleanse her body of all evils and impurities with a good scrub—also providing the same bottomed-out view. However, should you choose to, which you can with our Jason and Lucia relationship guide on how to build your bond , you can bring the two closer together. Eventually, once you’ve firmly reconnected them, you’ll be able to have sex in GTA 6 , which can prompt some steamy naked sex scenes. Unfortunately, it doesn’t appear that GTA 6 has full frontal nudity for Jason and Lucia. “Boo,” I can hear you cry! I’m sorry. But unless there is a late-game or post-game feature or function that allows this, it appears that Jason and Lucia don’t have full-frontal nudity. Rockstar Games emphasized in the build-up to the game’s launch the tastefulness of Jason and Lucia’s relationship. It means there are no sex workers in GTA 6, and Jason and Lucia can’t be properly intimate with anyone else. However, Rockstar has drawn the line at being able to see Jason and Lucia’s more exposed parts. You can catch a glimpse of Lucia’s top half when she’s getting into the shower, but that’s about it! The infamous CYBERLEEKS videos showed Jason and Lucia fully naked from all angles, but in hindsight, it seems this was modded and not representative of the final gameplay. CYBERLEEK had access to the GTA 6 build and could pretty much do whatever. A topless Lucia gameplay leak was the first major moment where we all thought GTA 6 was going to be extra wild. Other videos showed a totally nude Lucia exploring the map , along with an exposed Jason; however, it didn’t add up. Civilians weren’t reacting to the naked characters, which didn’t align with GTA 6’s lively, reactive world. There would be police action and other knock-on effects. So, in the end, it makes sense that the final product doesn’t have full-frontal nudity for Jason and Lucia. Obviously, if a new breakthrough is discovered, or something changes, we’ll let you know. So keep checking back here at Insider Gaming. Was this not the answer you were hoping for? Let us know your thoughts about the game via the free Insider Gaming Discord server . sources.name: IGN
sources.title: Cyberleek Returns for GTA 6 Launch to Reportedly Release a Near-Complete Xbox Build, Threatens to Release the Game's Executable in Days
sources.text: Cyberleek has returned for the launch of GTA 6 to allegedly release a near complete Xbox build of the game — and has threatened to release its executable in just days. It was thought that the person or group responsible for the online Cyberleek persona had ended their spate of GTA 6 leaks last month, after their memecoin crashed despite efforts to boost its market cap. In October, Cyberleek had tied various types of GTA 6 gameplay leaks to the Cyberleek market cap, and threatened to release a build of the game — supposedly over 200 GB in size — if the memecoin hit a $30 million market cap. Gameplay clips reportedly leaked at the time allegedly showed Lucia fully naked — something that is not possible in the final launch version of the game. Yesterday, November 19 — the GTA 6 release date — Cyberleek returned to drop a GTA 6 Xbox build without the game's executable. In a statement reportedly published online , Cyberleek claimed this Xbox build is a “full November 2026 build of GTA 6.” They predicted this Xbox build would be used to emulate GTA 6 on PC “within a week, running far past 30fps.” The console version of GTA 6 targets 30fps across all platforms, although struggles at times to hit that on base PS5 and Xbox Series X and S. Cyberleek has revived their crypto scheme, promising to release the executable immediately if it hits a $15 million market cap. While the CyberLeek memecoin was boosted in value by the news to $1.9 million yesterday, it is unlikely to get anywhere near the target. Still, Cyberleek has vowed to release the final file anyway on November 23, whether the memecoin hits the market cap or not. The release of a full and recent build of GTA 6 would of course be hugely damaging for Rockstar and parent company Take-Two, which appears to have been unable to deter Cyberleek’s actions in any meaningful way since their spate of leaks began. It would also run counter to the thought that Cyberleek only had access to an early development build of GTA 6, a feeling that was reinforced not only by the videos that were released, but by the differences that have emerged following the game’s official launch. Fans are calling on people not to spend money on Cyberleek, pointing out the leaker cashed out back in August and did again in October. Analysis of cryptocurrency transactions in late August pointed to the GTA 6 leaker cashing out having earnt around $270,000. IGN had reported on fan skepticism around the alleged leaked gameplay that reportedly showed both Jason and Lucia fully naked . A previous leaked gameplay video allegedly showed a tank spawning into the world, which suggested access to a dev menu of some kind. The leaked videos allegedly showing both Jason and Lucia fully naked also show NPCs failing to react to that in any way, which suggested this effect was achieved with either a dev menu or cheats. Cyberleek had threatened Rockstar and Take-Two with the release of a full playthrough of the game’s story if they failed to release GTA 6 on-disc and issue a public apology — and the market cap of the memecoin hit $30 million. Of course, few believe these GTA 6 leaks are about campaigning for physical media — rather they're about making money from a crypto scam. Cyberleek appeared to go dark after a spate of high-profile GTA 6 leaks in August that sparked an investigation from Take-Two. The company issued subpoenas to the likes of Discord as part of the hunt for the person or group of people responsible. It remains unclear how the gameplay footage, or any potential build of the game it's taken from, escaped the confines of Rockstar's infamous tight security. In August, Rockstar addressed the GTA 6 leaks , describing the situation as "heartbreaking" for its development team and "unfortunate" for fans. At the time, the developer acknowledged that its intended experience for players "may now be impacted by some spoilers," but reiterated GTA 6's previously-confirmed launch date of November 19. Whether the culprit or culprits are ever caught may rest on how successful Take-Two's legal team and the relevant authorities are at forcing social networks or crypto exchanges to divulge any personal details they hold on those responsible. sources.title: Cyberleek claims to release development build of GTA 6
sources.text: Cyberleek is back for the first time since GTA 6’s release Hacker group Cyberleek has returned for the first time since Grand Theft Auto 6’s launch and is claiming to have released a development build of the game on their site. The site’s latest update shows a link titled: “ XBOX BUILD 1.0.2.1 (NOV 2026)”. Screenshots being shared on social media appear to show that the files are from a development build of GTA 6’s Xbox release. The executable file is missing, preventing people with access from playing the build themselves. In a statement, Cyberleek threatened to release the executable at a later date. “It is done,” the statement reads. “CL [Cyberleek] holds the full November 2026 build of Grand Theft Auto VI, and it is going out by torrent. Now. Every file except one â the main executable â held on a countdown. “It is an Xbox build this time, not a PC build. CL does not care. This community will have it emulated inside a week, running far past 30fps. CL told you not to preorder for a reason. This is one of the reasons. “If the Xbox build cannot be made to work and support holds, CL will work to get a PS5 build â a fallback, most likely never required. Either way: the Xbox build is going out. No double dipping for Take-Two / Rockstar .” Cyberleek goes on to say that the release of the executable file is on a timer. However, they also say they will release it earlier if their crypto token reaches a certain market value. This comes as part of Cyberleek’s ongoing campaign against Rockstar , which they claim is in aid of consumer rights. They say they take particular issue with GTA 6 being a digital-only release. The group has been posting authentic gameplay clips from Grand Theft Auto 6 for months, even ahead of Rockstarâs own official Netflix reveal . However, Cyberleek has also enriched themselves greatly throughout this process. They have always encouraged crypto donations, and even made them mandatory if fans wanted to participate in polls to decide what was leaked next. Take-Two previously indicated that its efforts to track down the leaker were ârapidly evolvingâ. The Rockstar parent company has filed multiple subpoenas to Discord, demanding information on specific servers and users.

sources.title: Cyberleek drops what they claim is a near-complete GTA 6 Xbox build online
sources.text: The leaked file is apparently around 200 GB. Mysterious GTA 6 leaker Cyberleek has reemerged in the wake of GTA 6's release with another leak: This time, they have released what they claim to be a near-complete build of GTA 6 on Xbox from November 2026. In their post, Cyberleek says they'll drop the one file they've withheld—the main executable—if their crypto coin reaches a $15 million market cap. Yeah, we're doing this again. Comments on a now-removed Reddit post say the leaked file is around 200 GB, which is close to the size of GTA 6 on consoles. Cyberleek says they will release the exe on November 23, no matter what. "It is an Xbox build this time, not a PC build. CL does not care. This community will have it emulated inside a week, running far past 30fps. CL told you not to preorder for a reason. This is one of the reasons," the posts read. "If the Xbox build cannot be made to work and support holds, CL will work to get a PS5 build—a fallback, most likely never required. Either way: the Xbox build is going out. No double dipping for Take-Two/Rockstar." Last we heard from Cyberleek was over a month ago, when they were threatening Take-Two with a " dead man's switch ", which many took to mean they'd either post major story spoilers or leak the game in its entirety. We've yet to see confirmation that the build is genuine, but that could come as soon as tonight. If it is, it'll be anywhere between a few days or hours before the executable comes: According to Cyberleek's site, their crypto currently sits at a $1.83 million cap. sources.title: GTA 6 Leaker ‘Cyberleek’ Reportedly Threatens to Release the XBOX Build
sources.text: A new report reveals that the infamous GTA 6 leaker ‘Cyberleek’ has threatened to release almost the entire XBOX build of the game. This isn’t the first time the leaker has threatened to do so; a month ago , Cyberleek said the same thing, revealing that if their cryptocurrency’s market value crossed $30 million, they would release a playable build. However, he cashed out soon after, and we haven’t heard much from the leaker since, other than some inappropriate Lucia leaks . Now, the leaker has decreased the milestone people need to reach for the build to be released. A new report by IGN informs players about the alleged GTA 6 XBOX build drop from Cyberleek. It seems that the leaker has dumped all the files of the XBOX build apart from the .exe file, which they claim to be a “full November 2026 build of GTA.” The leaker adds that this build would allow the community to emulate the game on PC and have it run way higher than its 30 FPS lock on console. If that build doesn’t work, Cyberleek will work towards getting a PS5 build to the players. At the time of writing, the market cap of Cyberleek’s meme coin sits at around $1.5 million, and it seems very unlikely that it can jump to $15 million in the next few days. So it seems like November 23 could be the day they eventually drop GTA 6’s XBOX build, but whether they have the XBOX build in hand is a different question altogether. If they do, it could be a big problem for Rockstar, considering the PC release date hasn’t been announced yet. Players will just have to wait and see whether what Cyberleek is alleging is indeed true, and the wait is not long, as November 23 arrives in 3 days. What are your thoughts on Cyberleek reportedly threatening to release the XBOX build of GTA 6? Leave your thoughts down in the comments, and join the official Insider Gaming Discord server . sources.name: PlayStation Blog
sources.title: Grand Theft Auto VI launches tomorrow, November 19
sources.text: The latest installment in the Grand Theft Auto series heads to the state of Leonida, home to the neon-soaked streets of Vice City and beyond. Jason and Lucia have always known the deck is stacked against them. But when an easy score goes wrong, they find themselves on the darkest side of the sunniest place in America, in the middle of a criminal conspiracy stretching across the state of Leonida — forced to rely on each other more than ever if they want to make it out alive. Grand Theft Auto VI arrives on PlayStation 5 Thursday, November 19, available at PlayStation Store. The game is set in the state of Leonida, home to the neon-soaked streets of Vice City and beyond in the biggest, most immersive evolution of the series yet. Jason grew up around grifters and crooks. After a stint in the Army trying to shake off his troubled teens, he found himself in the Keys doing what he knows best, working for local drug runners. Meeting Lucia could be the best or worst thing to ever happen to him. Jason knows how he’d like it to turn out but right now, it’s hard to tell. Lucia’s father taught her to fight as soon as she could walk, and life has been coming at her swinging ever since. Fighting for her family landed her in the Leonida Penitentiary. Sheer luck got her out but now more than anything, Lucia wants the good life her mom has dreamed of since their days in Liberty City. Instead of half-baked fantasies, Lucia is prepared to take matters into her own hands. Leonida is made up of six regions: Vice City, the Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia, and Mount Kalaga. Here’s a closer look at what makes each region unique. The glamour, hustle, and greed of America captured in a single city. Each neighborhood has something to offer, from the pastel art deco hotels and bright white sands of Ocean Beach, to the bustling panaderías of Little Cuba and the bootleg brands of the Tisha-Wocka flea market, out to the VC Port, the cruise ship capital of the world. We’re a long way from the ’80s, but Vice City is still the sun and fun capital of America Life in this tropical archipelago isn’t flashy but it’s easy. Get your buzz on and pull up a deck chair but look out — you are right on the doorstep of some of the most beautiful and dangerous waters in all of America. You never know what lies beneath the surface of this primordial expanse. The gators may be the most famous attraction, but there are far deadlier predators and weirder discoveries among the mangroves. Cheap motels, shut-down attractions, and empty strip malls won’t bring the tourists back, but there’s a new economy in this once-popular vacation spot. It’s fueled by malt liquor, painkillers, and truck stop energy drinks. In the heart of Leonida, American industry and old school values still reign supreme — whatever the cost. The Allied Crystal sugar refinery provides the jobs, while the local biker gang provides almost everything else. A national landmark up against the state’s northern border, Mount Kalaga offers prime hunting, fishing, and off-road trails. In the lush surrounding backwoods, hillbilly mystics and paranoid radicals live far from the prying eyes of the government. Spanning stations including Classic Rock, Modern Hip-Hop, Pop, Metal, Dance, Latin, ‘80s, Electronic, Blues, Ballads, Talk Radio, and much more, Grand Theft Auto VI features the biggest and widest-ranging selection of in-game radio yet. Plus, for the first time ever, Grand Theft Auto VI introduces a series of on-demand podcasts for Jason and Lucia to experience beyond Leonida’s terrestrial radio, with both radio and podcasts available to listen to in vehicles and on foot through newly introduced headphones and earbuds connected to their smartphones.

sources.title: Grand Theft Auto VI chega amanhã, dia 19 de novembro
sources.text: O mais novo título da série Grand Theft Auto nos leva ao estado de Leonida, até as ruas iluminadas de neon de Vice City e além. Jason e Lucia sempre souberam que as cartas não estavam a favor deles. Mas quando o que deveria ser um trabalho fácil dá errado, eles se encontram no lado mais escuro do lugar mais ensolarado da América, no meio de uma conspiração criminosa que cobre todo o estado de Leonida, forçados a depender um do outro mais do que nunca se quiserem sair vivos. Grand Theft Auto VI chega para PlayStation 5 quinta-feira, 19 de novembro, disponível na PlayStation Store. O jogo se passa no estado de Leonida, onde ficam as ruas banhadas de neon de Vice City e além, na maior e mais imersiva evolução da série até hoje. Jason cresceu rodeado de bandidos e vigaristas. Após um período no exército para tentar se livrar de sua adolescência perturbada, ele se encontra nos Keys fazendo o que faz melhor, trabalhando para traficantes de drogas locais. Conhecer Lucia pode ser a melhor ou a pior coisa que já aconteceu com ele. Jason sabe como gostaria que tudo terminasse, mas agora, é difícil prever. O pai de Lucia a ensinou a lutar desde que ela aprendeu a andar, e a vida tem vindo com tudo para cima dela desde então. Lutar por sua família a colocou na Penitenciária de Leonida. Sorte pura a livrou desta vez, mas agora mais do que qualquer coisa, Lucia deseja a vida boa com a qual sua mãe sonhava desde que moravam em Liberty City. Em vez de fantasias pela metade, Lucia está preparada para assumir o controle da situação. Leonida é composto de seis regiões: Vice City, as Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia, e Mount Kalaga. Vamos conhecer o que torna cada região única. O glamour, o trabalho e a ganância da América capturados em uma única cidade. Cada bairro tem algo a oferecer, dos hóteis de art deco, cores pastel e areia branca de Ocean Beach, até as padarias de Little Cuba e as marcas falsificadas do mercadinho de Tisha-Wocka, até o VC Port, a capital mundial dos navios de cruzeiro. Estamos longe dos anos 80, mas Vice City ainda é a capital do sol e da diversão da América. A vida neste arquipélago tropical não é chamativa, mas é boa. Pegue uma cervejinha e puxe uma cadeira de praia, mas tome cuidado, você está à beira das águas mais belas e perigosas da América. Você nunca sabe o que está sob a superfície desta região primordial. Os jacarés podem ser a atração mais famosa, mas há predadores bem mais perigosos e descobertas mais estranhas entre o manguezal. Motéis baratos, atrações fechadas, e galerias de lojas vazias e abandonadas não vão trazer os turistas de volta, mas há uma nova economia neste local que já foi um ponto turístico. Agora mandam o as bebidas baratas, remédios contra a dor e bebidas energéticas. No coração de Leonida, a indústria Americana e os antigos valores ainda reinam supremos, seja qual for o custo. A refinaria de açúcar Allied Crystal providencia os empregos, e a gangue de motociclistas local providencia quase todo o resto. Um marco nacional na fronteira norte do estado, Mount Kalaga oferece as melhores trilhas off-road e pontos de pesca e caça. Nas florestas em torno, caipiras místicos e radicais paranóicos vivem longe dos olhos vigilantes do governo. Com estações de Rock Clássico, Hip-Hop Moderno, Pop, Metal, Dance, Latina, Anos 80, Electrônica, Blues, Baladas, Talk Radio, e muito mais, Grand Theft Auto VI possui a maior e mais variada seleção de rádios em um jogo até hoje. Além disso, pela primeira vez, Grand Theft Auto VI apresenta uma série de podcasts sob demanda para Jason e Lucia ouvirem além das rádios de Leonida, com ambos disponíveis para ouvir em veículos e a pé usando fones de ouvido e earbuds conectados aos seus smartphones.

sources.name: Xbox Wire
sources.title: How to Get Ready for November 19
sources.text: November 19, 2026, has long been circled on your calendar. Birthdays, anniversaries, and holidays have come and gone, but this day belongs to you and your XBOX console. We can hardly believe it’s almost here, either. Once midnight strikes, you want to be locked in the action, so to help you prepare, we created a checklist to ensure distractions are put to bed so you can settle in for a season of gaming like nothing you’ve ever experienced before. 2026 has been full of some absolute bangers: Gears of War E-Day, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, Forza Horizon 6, Halo: Campaign Evolved, Minecraft Dungeons II, Diablo 4: Lord of Hatred , Control Resonant , Mixtape , Pragmata , The Blood of Dawnwalker , Star Wars: Galactic Racer , 007 First Light , Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve … seriously, all these games came out this year . That also means you might have a hard drive that is nearing capacity. And you will be faced with some hard choices to free up approximately 212GB of space on your XBOX Series X|S before November 19. You could always upgrade the capacity of your console to keep all your games at the ready, using the storage expansion slot on the back of the console. Otherwise, you’ll have a hard choice to make which we do not envy. But know that you’re in good company – we had to find a way to make room too. XBOX Cloud Gaming means that you don’t need to own an XBOX Series X|S console to experience the latest games (or use up that hard drive space) – you can stream directly from the cloud to your XBOX One console. Game Pass subscribers receive an allotment of hours per month as part of their plans, but you can also purchase blocks of time . Certain upcoming major releases have been confirmed as cloud-ready on day one , so even if you don’t own a current gen console, your latest obsession isn’t out of reach. You never want to settle in for a long gaming session only to immediately get hit with an update download. If you haven’t used your XBOX Series X|S or XBOX One in a minute, be sure to power up and connect to the internet beforehand and make sure you’re all set with the latest system updates. You can also install any upcoming releases you may have pre-ordered, while you’re at it. If you’re feeling a gaming flu coming on (and there’s a lot of that going around right now), then take a sick day, rather than risk infecting your coworkers or classmates. Sometimes you just need to listen to your body’s needs, relax, and let the fever run its course. Miami’s own DJ Khaled, aka Dr. XBOX will write you a personalized note to help explain the situation. If this thing is really serious, you may even need the whole week to recover – it’s the responsible thing to do. We all have responsibilities. Some of them come with four legs and a suspect bladder. Don’t let Rufus ruin your gaming fun. Get ahold of a local dog walker to take them outside so you can enjoy the big day uninterrupted. Or drop them off at doggie daycare for a day (or week) to get them out of your hair. Is your XBOX in an area of the house that is easily accessible to younger players? Consider the steps you need to take to get it out of younger sightlines, like running an extension cable out to the shed in the backyard or huddling up in your at-home office. Even if you do find yourself bouncing between rooms, your save files reside in the Cloud, allowing you to pick up your session wherever you last plugged your console in. We’re always on the hunt for new tunes and one of the things we’re most looking forward to on November 19 is discovering a whole bunch of new tracks that are sure to make our listening playlist pop throughout the year. You can get started here on Spotify . XBOX Design Lab lets you create your own next-gen XBOX Wireless Controller. Choose from a combination of colors, patterns, textured grips, and more. You could even pick up some specially themed versions of controllers styled in hot pink and pastels – this one is particularly striking . Speaking of controllers, if you expect long gaming sessions in your near future, make sure that it’s plugged in so it has a full charge when you need it, or stock up on AA batteries. Maybe even get a backup controller ready so you can hot-swap them in and minimize interruptions. Looking for something to add to your queue? Check out the 1967 classic, “Bonnie and Clyde,” featuring Warren Beatty and Faye Dunaway to get you in the mood for an epic story about two tragic lovers who fall into a life of crime. We’ll have to wait and see if the outcome is any different this time around starting on November 19.

sources.title: How to get Paul Walker's Fast and Furious car in GTA 6
sources.text: Get your hands on the classic bright green Fast and Furious Mitsubishi Eclipse in GTA 6 Finding, buying, and stealing your dream car or bike is a peak part of Grand Theft Auto, and mine is the Fast and Furious Mitsubishi Eclipse in GTA 6, based on the bright green car driven by Paul Walker as Brian O'Conner in the original movie. This gorgeous motor can be found locked in a garage in Vice City, but it can be stolen, and, if you play your cards right, you can even register it as your own for free. Here's how. To find Paul Walker's Fast and Furious Mitsubishi in GTA 6, you need to head towards Vice Beach, to the east of Vice City. The car is locked in a garage on Vespucci Island, one of the Rialto Islands to the west of Vice Beach. You can see the exact location marked on the map above. You'll have to break into the garage and steal the car, which is actually a lot easier than it sounds, but I've got more details on that below. As you'd expect, the Mitsubishi handles really well and hits high speeds, so it's one of the best GTA 6 cars you can get your hands on, especially in the early game, for free, and without picking up too much heat. To steal Paul Walker's GTA 6 car, head to the garage and break in. This triggers an alarm, but you can switch that off pretty quickly on the wall to your left as you head in. Open the garage door here too, break into the car, hotwire it, and drive away - simple as that. There are a few additional details to note here, though, that make this experience easier or better for you overall. For more on car ownership in GTA 6, which can be done at any Pay 'n' Spray for a cost, check out our guide to GTA 6 personal vehicles . sources.text: If it were as easy to steal a Tank in real life as it is in GTA 6, society would have a serious problem. Thankfully, it’s not easy, and while GTA 6 isn’t a walk in the park, there’s an efficient method ot get yourself a Tank. I still remember that feeling of getting into a Tank in GTA 3 and running amok in Liberty City, with cars instantly exploding if they barely touched me. GTA 6 also carries on the Tank tradition, and there’s a consistent way to get one. You can buy Grand Theft Auto 6 here if you haven’t already! The most reliable location to find a Tank in GTA 6 is in the Mile Zero Air Station. I replicated this method a few times to ensure it works. You can find the Mile Zero Air Station in the south region of the map, southwest of Key Lento—the main starting strip. It’s a typically secure military base, with one glaring oversight allowing you to get in with ease. It has a whole host of vehicles and goodies in there, but by far the most appealing of all is the Tank. To do this, you need Body Armor and ideally a car, and you need to head to the southeast section of the base where there’s a convenient dirt ramp that you can use to leap into the base. Here’s the most efficient method to do this: Now that you’re in the base, head to the south of the base, and you’ll find a large gathering of vehicles, including Tanks. Take your Tank and go have fun in GTA 6. Fortunately, you don’t immediately trigger a 6-Star Wanted Level when you enter the base, as has happened in previous GTA games. Obviously, stealing a Tank and blowing stuff up will make those stars pile up very quickly. Simply, head to the Destination marker in the screenshot above, or head to the south of the base in general, and it’s hard to miss an armada of military vehicles,s including Tanks. sources.title: How to Get A Jet in GTA 6—Best Jet Method & Location
sources.text: If you want to jet off in GTA 6, you need a Jet. It’s that simple. GTA 6’s openness actually makes this possible once you gain proper access to Leonida, and we know the easiest Jet location in Vice City and how to get one. We’ve already covered how to easily get a Tank in GTA 6 . But if you want a dominant vehicle to use in the air, you can’t go wrong with a military Jet. Find out how with this easy guide in GTA 6 . You can find a Jet in the Mile Zero Air Station, effectively the military base, in GTA 6. The Mile Zero Air Station military base is southwest of Key Lento. It’s surprisingly close and accessible to the beginning of the game, but I wouldn’t advise it until a few hours in when you have the right resources. For a tight, shoot-on-sight policy military base, it has an easy way to get in. A sturdy car and Body Armor are the two main tools you need to get a Jet in GTA 6, allowing you to enter the base with a handy ramp. A litany of Jets await you near the middle of the military base, and you can find them near the main runways, as pointed out above, in GTA 6’s Mile Zero Air Station. The Jet is armed with a machine gun and missiles. You’re basically in control of a flying, high-speed death machine. A 6-Star Wanted Level is almost a guarantee once you start blowing stuff up. sources.name: IGN
sources.title: Amazon Drops Lightning Deals on Some of the Best Modern Board Games for Black Friday
sources.text: You can never have too many board games. With video games and TV dominating our attention on a daily basis, there's nothing better than sitting down and having a physical experience with your family and friends. A good game of Monopoly or Scrabble is always entertaining, but if you're looking to upgrade to something a bit more modern, Black Friday sales are a great time to do so. Amazon just dropped a number of Lightning Deals on some of our favorite modern tabletop games in 2026. Amazon's Black Friday sale kicked off on November 19, so these board game deals are new to today. You can dive into our top picks right here or scroll down for some of IGN's reviews on these games. Seeing as these are Lightning Deals, we don't expext these discounts to last through the weekend. The majority of Amazon's new board game deals are from Asmodee. That's not too surprising considering they own a variety of different studios. While we haven't reviewed every board game on this list, we have played all of them and can attest to just how fun they are. If you're looking for new tabletop experiences, any of these options are an easy recommendation. You can check out some of our hands-on reviews with these games below if you want to know more about the experience. This is one of the best Lord of the Rings board games on the market right now. We gave it an 8 out of 10 score in our review : "Lord of the Rings: Fate of the Fellowship expands on the 2008's Pandemic game system and manages to create one of the best Lord of the Ring tabletop experiences out there, but its increased reliance on random card draws and dice rolls can lead to some turns feeling wasted, or that you are biding your time for what you need, detracting from the game's excitement." - Scott White If you're looking for a racing board game, look no further than this one right here. We gave this game a 9 out of 10 in our review : "Heat: Pedal to the Metal is a vivid and delightful racing board game that surpasses the accomplishments of all that came before it. It’s an inspired title in both product and design, offering a range of options while presenting a dynamic racing system that is extremely impressive." - Charlie Theel For a fun and unique family board game , Harmonies is an excellent choice. We gave it an 8 out of 10 in our review : "Harmonies masterfully blends its drafting system and token-laying mechanics to create a satisfying gameplay loop with just the right amount of tension in its decision-making. At its core, it's an elegant optimization puzzle that offers a fresh challenge every time you play. The added verticality introduces another layer of strategy as you work to build the perfect mix of habitats. Its playful, inviting design features vibrant colors and beautifully illustrated animal cards that are a joy to engage with throughout the game. It's quick to set up and easy to teach, making it a great fit for families and couples, while still offering enough crunchy decisions to keep seasoned players satisfied." - Matt Adler If you're looking for a fun strategy game with civilization elements, 7 Wonders will be right up your alley. It's not for everyone, but it's still worth picking up at this price. We gave it a 7 out of 10 in our review : "You can’t argue with the sheer number of copies that 7 Wonders has sold, nor the plethora of awards that it has accrued. This is a fun game, a good way to pass a half hour, with a great balance of luck and strategy. But it got that way by spreading itself quite thin, making a lot of gamers fairly happy rather than bringing ecstasy to smaller fanbases. There are times when the lack of theme and long-term strategy makes it feel more like an exercise than a game and it’s a tad too involved for casual family play. But whatever kind of games you like, if you fancy taking the plunge, you’re almost guaranteed to find plenty of enjoyment." - Matt Thrower Jacob Kienlen is a Senior Audience Development Strategist and Writer for IGN. sources.title: Sam Houser: with GTA 6, Rockstar "tried to create an experience that will exceed your expectations while showing what this medium is capable of"
sources.text: Rockstar co-founder issues rare public statement as the firm's latest release launches worldwide Rockstar Games president and co-founder Sam Houser has issued a rare statement as GTA 6 launches, celebrating the game's debut and its glowing critical reception . "Rockstar Games was founded on the belief that games could achieve the same distinction as all other forms of storytelling, become essential to modern culture, and to be thought of as stories and worlds that live on with all of us," said Houser in a statement shared with IGN . "This week, Grand Theft Auto returns to Leonida and modern-day Vice City. While things have changed and time has passed, one aspect holds true: We have tried to create an experience that will exceed your expectations while showing what this medium is capable of, and why we believe games are so special. "Whether you can trace your journey to this game through the entire series or are experiencing Grand Theft Auto for the first time, this is a narrative set in a world full of possibilities – and it is up to you as the player to shape how it ultimately feels, and concludes. "We hope it felt both familiar and entirely new, and above all, we hope that you had fun. We are incredibly grateful to you and everything that you do to celebrate games. We look forward to many more years of sharing these experiences with you. The game is currently available to players in New Zealand and Australia, and will unlock at midnight on the 19th in other territories. The review embargo lifted this morning, with the game receiving near-universal critical acclaim and setting record viewership figures on YouTube and Twitch .

sources.title: Rockstar Wouldn’t Confirm Or Deny If That’s Studio President Sam Houser In GTA 6
sources.text: Cameo GTA 3 GTA 6 Rob Nelson Rockstar Games Sam Houser Grand Theft Auto 6 contains some surprising and fun cameos and moments, including what appears to be a strange appearance by Rockstar Games co-founder and company president Sam Houser. I asked Rockstar about this cameo and got some laughs and (mostly) confirmation that it’s him in the game. During a pre-release interview with Rockstar’s head of production Rob Nelson , who acted as basically the director behind GTA 6 , I asked a lot of questions about things I found while playing the newly released open-world sequel for over 150 hours. And I had to ask about a strange cameo that happens late in the middle half of the game’s main story. An older man appears wearing a shirt featuring the Rockstar Games logo. He’s called Little Sam and doesn’t say anything. All signs pointed to this being Sam Houser. So I asked Nelson about this cameo and got a laugh from him and Rockstar PR in the Zoom chat. “Little Sam?” replied Nelson with a smirk. “I mean, I can’t I can confirm or deny it. I think it’ll be very interesting when fans see that.” Nelson then laughed more. I pointed out that Sam Houser had a voice cameo as a gun store clerk in GTA 3 , something Nelson was well aware of, and so it seemed very likely this was him. Little Sam looks a lot like Houser in this recent pic posted online a year ago . “[He was in GTA 3 ,] so I wouldn’t be surprised if that’s him. sources.text: Diehard GameCube fans can connect the controller to their original console, or use it with the Switch. Diehard GameCube fans can connect the controller to their original console, or use it with the Switch. If you buy something from a link, The Verge may earn a commission. See our ethics statement. The 8BitDo 64 was a loose remake of the Nintendo 64’s unusual triple-grip controller that did away with that gamepad’s centered analog stick. But with its new GC Bluetooth Gamepad , 8BitDo has done a much better job at staying faithful to the design of the Nintendo GameCube’s excellent controllers, including their unique button layout, thumbstick design, and shoulder buttons. The 8BitDo GC Bluetooth Gamepad is available for preorder starting today for $49.99 in orange or purple and is expected to start shipping on December 10th. That’s much cheaper than Nintendo’s $69.99 wireless remake of the GameCube controller, although 8BitDo’s version isn’t an exact copy of the original’s shape and ergonomics. If that’s important to you, and you have your GameCube’s original accessories on hand, you can still buy 8BitDo’s $25.98 upgrade kit, which is a cheaper way to make it compatible with modern consoles and devices. 8BitDo’s GameCube redux carries forward the original’s octagonal gates around the base of each thumbstick, making it well-suited to playing fighting games like Super Smash Bros. Ultimate . And while Nintendo continues to skip modern thumbstick technologies , the 8BitDo GC features both drift-resistant TMR thumbsticks and Hall effect linear triggers. The controller connects to all versions of the Nintendo Switch over Bluetooth, as well as PCs or handheld consoles running Windows. It also comes with a 2.4GHz wireless USB receiver for players who prefer a connection with lower latency, or you can connect it with a USB-C cable for the best possible performance.

sources.title: Delete GTA 6 from your hard drive and indie publisher Devolver Digital might give you a free game
sources.text: GTA 6 is out at midnight everywhere (19th November), but it's far from the only game in town. Indie publisher Devolver Digital is taking on the open-world behemoth with its very own Volvy's Adventure: Reslimed, out the same day, and you can win a free copy of the platformer by proving you've deleted GTA 6 off your hard drive. "Want a free copy of November's hottest release? Repost this tweet with a video of you deleting your GTA6 pre-load along with #MakeRoomForVolvy for a chance to win a copy of Volvy's Adventure: Reslimed on Steam," the publisher wrote on social media . It's not every day you see a publisher promote its own games by asking folks to delete another company's release, but arguably the wildest part of the giveaway is that Volvy's Adventure isn't launching on consoles. Even if you were to scrub GTA 6's 212GB pre-load from your PS5 or Xbox, you're definitely not making room for Volvy. "Heads up: Volvy's Adventure: Reslimed is launching exclusively on PC. While we expect to see console GTA deletions in your submissions, Steam keys are the only prize available for this giveaway," Devolver noted. Devolver made quite an amusing GTA 6 parody trailer, as well, which sees Volvy and Miss Volvy running from the police and getting steamy in the shower. I've embedded it up above for your viewing pleasure. For the unaware, Volvy used to be a common fixture at Devolver Digital's frequently bonkers notE3 presentations. He's now somewhat of a company mascot . But while Volvy's Adventure: Reslimed is being presented as a "much-anticipated remaster of the original remake of the hit action-platformer," this is, in fact, Volvy's first proper game. Making up an elaborate history for Volvy is just part of the publisher's long-running and increasingly questionable gag. Gunbrella and Gato Robot developer doinksoft is behind this one, a throwback side-scrolling platformer where our mouse-like mascot uses his oversized hand to helicopter over gaps, punch through roadblocks and, erm, fist himself underground, per the game's Steam page . Devolver Digital has been waiting to steal Rockstar's thunder for well over a year now. The publisher threatened to release a game on GTA 6's release date way back in May 2025, and has pushed back its plan with each new GTA 6 delay. Gotta respect the commitment, at least.

sources.title: Should you kill or spare Arnold in GTA 6?
sources.text: Deciding whether to kill or spare Arnold in GTA 6 is the culmination of the Hey Arnold mission in Chapter 1, the 7th after you encounter Mandy during Pipework. Essentially, Arnold, Brian's business partner, has gone dark, so you're sent to rough him up. Arnold and his cronies will do a runner, hopping into a vehicle and speeding off. You'll need to chase them down and do a bit of high-speed shooting. This will lead to an on-foot chase, at the end of which you'll corner him on a pier, where he'll explain he wants to leave the criminal life behind and disappear. There are two choices and consequences: Funnily enough, if you choose neither and just wait, Arnold will leave, though this will result in the same outcome as if you decided to spare him. Besides this, there are no downsides to sparing him or advantages gained through killing him. sources.title: Should you kill or spare Arnold in GTA 6?
sources.text: Your choice to spare or kill Arnold in GTA 6 has consequences In the mission 'Hey Arnold!' you face your first moral dilemma: do you kill or spare Arnold in GTA 6? After Brian's shady business associate, Arnold, goes dark during GTA 6 Chapter 1 , Jason, Brian, and Cal hunt him down to the radar station near the Aerostat. It turns out Arnold isn't very happy with Brian's drug-dealing tactics and, after some heated words, Arnold and his goons jump into a pickup truck and speed off. But no one disrespects Brian like that, not on Jason's watch, and a high speed car chase immediately ensues. When the chase ends, you must choose whether to let Arnold live or execute him, with your choice having consequences for your GTA 6 criminal profile . If you continue chasing Arnold to the Key Lento Marina, he abandons his vehicle and Brian tells Jason to "shut him up." Though, he doesn't specify how. He simply says: "Do whatever you have to do." You then need to chase after Arnold on foot (hopefully you've been working on your fitness) until you get close enough to tackle him or he reaches the end of the pier and has nowhere else to run. He then begins to beg Jason for his life. To spare Arnold, hold down L2/LT to interact with him and press X/A to select the option to 'Spare' him. If you spare Arnold, Jason will threaten him and let him go. This also happens if you don't make any choice. In return, you receive a contribution toward the Restrained criminal profile and Arnold scuttles off, with Brian none the wiser. Arnold will then make a small cameo in a later GTA 6 mission . There are two ways you can kill Arnold in this GTA 6 mission . The first is to complete the car chase to the Marina and then follow Arnold on foot until he reaches the end of the pier or you're able tackle him to the ground. However, when he starts begging for his life, you can instead execute him with your weapon. If you do this, you receive a warning that "Indiscriminate violence will contribute toward a violent criminal profile." If you'd rather not deal with Arnold's begging – or a pesky foot chase – you can kill Arnold by shooting at his vehicle and/or him during the car chase. Killing Arnold in this way is quicker, but contributes toward a Ruthless criminal profile. The choice of whether or not to kill Arnold has no major impact on GTA 6's story. This mission essentially acts as a tutorial for GTA 6's criminal profile mortality system. Whichever choice you make, the following cutscene and rewards will be the same. The only difference is that, if you let Arnold live, he makes a small (but incosequential) cameo in a later mission. So, if you want to see the shady businessman again later or are building toward a professional criminal profile, let Arnold live. If you don't care whatsoever about Arnold or are building toward a violent criminal profile, you should kill Arnold. Weekly digests, tales from the communities you love, and more © GamesRadar+. sources.title: Should you give the statue to Benedict Halifax in GTA 6?
sources.text: Or should you not trust the eccentric antiques dealer? Deciding whether to give the statue to Benedict Halifax is a decision you'll need to make during the fourth story mission of Chapter 3 in GTA 6 , called Dubious Provenance. This mission will kick off after Cal visits the Bayside apartment you're borrowing from Boobie to inspect the hard drive. Once Cal leaves, you'll see an icon of a statuette at the closet door. Remember, you didn't just acquire a hard drive but a bronze statuette in Chapter 1, and if you interact with it now the mission will begin. First, you need to drive to Capri, a ritzy town on the other side of the map. At the antiques store, Evelyn Andrews tells you she isn't interested in the obviously stolen item, but art dealer Benedict Halifax approaches you on the sly and says he can have it appraised for you. Should you give the statue to him? So, you might as well just give it to him. Things shake out the same way no matter what you choose, but not giving it to him just means the mission will ultimately take longer to complete. sources.text: Complete Jason's house repairs before Lucia arrives. One of the last tasks in GTA 6 's home repair mission for Jason is to fix the railing. These tasks are important if you want Lucia to have a positive welcome when she gets out of jail, so they're well worth doing if you plan to foster a romance between the two criminal lovers. You have to fix the rooftiles, put up the panels in Jason's bedroom and paint them, repair the stairs up to the decking at the front, and finally, fix the railing. This one is slightly less obvious, but you just need to: You can also just watch the clip above if unsure. The other tasks are relatively simple if you haven't found them yet also. Climb the ladder outside the front door to repair the roof tiles, interact with the stacked panels at the foot of Jason's bed to put them up, and you can repair the stairs at the front by interacting with the pile of planks at the bottom.
